maps.name: The Overgrown Temple
maps.environment: Sunlit Maya jungle with ancient ruins reclaimed by roots. Warm light, green and gold, visible sky haze.
weather: warm rain shower event (about 40 s every 4-5 min, reduces visibility 10%)
maps.trees: broadleaf, palm, ceiba (giant), strangler fig, young saplings; 6 canopy colour variants of green plus a few flowering ones
maps.rocks: mossy boulders, stone slabs, rubble piles, fallen stelae
maps.ground: moss grass, packed dirt paths, cobbled plaza, shallow mud
buildings: ruined market stalls with faded cloth
maps.landmarks: Central plaza with the temple; four hut clusters at the corners; a dry fountain; a long avenue of stelae.
maps.ambience: jungle day birds, insects, distant waterfall, light wind

maps.name: Temple Under a Blood Moon
maps.environment: The same temple district at night under a red moon: burned huts, ritual platforms, bones, torchlight in the dark. Reduced visibility; torches are the readable landmarks.
weather: ash storm event (about 30 s every 5 min, reduces visibility 20% and adds wind sound)
maps.trees: dead gnarled trees, burned stumps, hanging vine curtains, thorn bushes
maps.rocks: obsidian shards, cracked altar stones, bone piles
maps.ground: ash ground, cracked stone, dark packed dirt with red veins
maps.landmarks: A ritual platform in the centre; a burned village ring; torch avenues leading to the platform.
maps.ambience: night wind, crackling fire, low drone, distant howls

maps.name: The Sunken Cenote
maps.environment: A vast underground cavern with a turquoise lake, glowing crystals, and a submerged temple gate. Cold blue and violet light, bioluminescence.
weather: light rays from a ceiling opening (permanent, subtle)
rockfall event (small rocks with shadow markers, about 20 s every 5 min)
maps.trees: hanging roots, giant cave tree roots, mushroom clusters (large), ferns
maps.rocks: stalagmites, crystal clusters (several colours), wet boulders
maps.ground: wet stone, shallow water (slows the player 20%), sand banks, glowing moss
maps.landmarks: A central lake with a shrine island; a gate at the north wall; crystal fields in the corners.
maps.ambience: cave drips, flowing water, low reverberant hum, bats
